tagline: A historic seaside village near the airport — elegant old houses, a quiet marina, and a surprisingly calm seaside promenade far from the city's intensity.

items.name: Yeşilköy İskelesi Cafés
items.description: Cafés near the old ferry landing with sea views. A beautifully unhurried atmosphere for a morning coffee.

items.name: Yeşilköy Balık Restoranları
items.description: Fish restaurants near the marina with Marmara views. Very local crowd — no tourists. Excellent value.

items.name: Yeşilköy Tarihi Sahil Yürüyüşü
items.description: A walk through the historic village streets with beautifully preserved 19th-century summer houses and along the seafront promenade.

tips: Yeşilköy is on the Marmaray (Yeşilköy station) — easy access from the city centre.
One of Istanbul's least-visited historic villages. Almost no tourists.
Combine with Florya (just north) for a pleasant coastal half-day.
The old Greek and Armenian summer houses are well preserved — worth walking slowly.
